text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel alone does not indicate bias; composition usually reflects available municipal leadership or HR personnel. For director-level roles, selection panels often prioritize executive presence, community engagement, and public consultation experience over formal degrees or years of service. 

Raising the panel's gender without concrete evidence of discriminatory conduct is legally tenuous and could significantly harm your professional reputation within municipal networks. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up inquiring about constructive feedback to strengthen future applications. Frame your inquiry entirely around your interview performance and competencies, keeping the tone professional and forward-looking.
